introHtml: Gold paper hand fans bring a touch of elegance to any event or promotion. Whether you're planning a wedding, corporate gala, or summer festival, these metallic fans catch the light and draw attention. Choose from full-color imprinting or foil stamping to match your brand colors. Their compact size makes them easy to hand out, and the gold finish ensures they won't be tossed aside. Perfect for outdoor ceremonies, trade shows, or any occasion where you want your logo to shine.
